profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | B.S. in Computer Science
profile.summary:
https://github.com/JoseWil-creator
I'm a hands-on engineer passionate about building, testing, and improving autonomous systems. With a strong foundation in ROS, Python, and JavaScript, I’ve contributed to AV system reliability through real-time diagnostics, data-driven dashboards, and full-stack tool development.

At Outrider, I help ensure the stability and performance of autonomous electric vehicles by integrating software tools, developing metrics dashboards, and collaborating cross-functionally to improve system health and uptime. My work spans field testing, ROS debugging, API development, and predictive maintenance strategies all with the goal of making autonomy more scalable and reliable.

I'm looking to grow with teams at the intersection of robotics, software, and field integration, where I can help bring next-gen autonomous tech to the real world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build and maintain the mapping software and data workflows behind autonomous yard trucks creating, validating, deploying, and troubleshooting the site annotation maps vehicles navigate by.
• Own production tooling for map delivery, versioning, and runtime site configuration, automating deployment and validation workflows used daily by engineering and operations across multiple customer sites.
• Develop ROS/Python pipelines for processing and analyzing LiDAR point clouds, from raw sensor bags through localization-grade map products.
• Build software for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test fixtures that automate verification of embedded vehicle hardware, software, and I/O against system requirements.
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Software Development and +10 skills

positions.title: Engineer II, Technical Operations
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented internal tools to automate and streamline support workflows
	•	Developed and maintained dashboards (Streamlit, Jira, Zendesk) for data-driven decision making
	•	Contributed to backend code for mapping pipelines and cloud configuration systems
	•	Investigated and triaged issues in autonomous vehicle missions, providing insights for root cause analysis
	•	Authored technical documentation to standardize troubleshooting and repair procedures
	•	Collaborated on cross-functional teams to resolve field escalations and improve system reliability

positions.title: Computer Science Student Tutor
positions.description:
• Provide in person and online tutoring in the Computer Science lab or CS student lounge for 
students in lower division computer science courses.
• Assists students to achieve academic success in current coursework and promote retention and 
persistence by assisting students with increasing confidence, skills, and ability in content areas by 
explaining concepts in different ways.
• Mastery of concepts and skills taught in relevant courses in the following areas: Basic
Programming – I/O processing, variables, conditions, loops, functions, arrays, list-arrays, linkedlist, trees, stacks, queues, classes, recursion, and more.
positions.insights: Command Prompt, Software Development and +12 skills

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with a Minor in Mathematics
